key_insight: Turbulence must be assessed jointly in space and time, because spatial and temporal evaluations can disagree for both numerical simulations and neural representations.
engineering_relevance: Reliable AI-based turbulence modeling requires validation of both fine-scale flow structures and temporal evolution, not spatial accuracy alone.
method: Analyze massive, time-resolved direct numerical simulations.
Assess how numerical choices affect resolved space–time turbulence.
Study neural network representations of the recorded flow.
evidence_signal: The study uses direct numerical simulations exceeding 28 TB per run and reports disagreement between spatial and temporal assessments.
watch_item: Fully resolved space–time data impose substantial storage and computational demands; the abstract does not quantify neural model accuracy.
paper_title: Let's Do Turbulence Right: In Space and Time!
